messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: billing-ledger sync unexpectedly returned 502s for a small subset of onboarding flows starting ~09:12 UTC. A few trials didn't get seat assignment confirmations and webhooks started retrying. I want to prepare proactive comms to affected customers (3 tenants).

alex_se: Looking. Root cause appears to be a retry storm hitting an edge case in the ledger service during queue backpressure. I'm pushing a targeted hotfix to tighten the retry backoff and guard the 502 path. ETA ~12m for first canary.

jordan_pmo: Two of the three tenants are mid-quarter renewal targets. Recommend we preempt churn risk with a tailored outreach + a compensatory offer. I'll coordinate on the renewal messaging.

maria_cs: Draft customer note incoming. Plan: concise impact summary, what we did, action for customer, credit + onboarding hours, link to feedback form, and an invite to an office hours slot. Keep it short.

emily_rev: For renewal-risk accounts, let's hold a separate note offering 10% credit and direct account exec touch. I'll follow up with the account IDs.

luis_support: I have open tickets: Tenant-Blue and Tenant-Green reported seat failures; Tenant-Orange opened a live support session. I'm joining Tenant-Orange now.

sarah_ops: Billing ops: can we automate the credit application? If we need manual steps it will slow SLA.

alex_se: After the canary verifies, I'll emit a verified-impacted-list and a small script you can run to apply credits in bulk.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed at 3700004400 — 1/3 instances. No spike in errors during canary window.

alex_se: Canary stable, rolling full rollout now. Expect full roll in ~4m.

maria_cs: Customer note (short):

"Hi <CustomerName>,

We detected a transient billing-ledger sync error between 09:12 and 09:44 UTC that may have prevented seat assignments for some trial conversions. We have deployed a fix, requeued pending tasks, and most impacted accounts are now progressing normally.

What we did:
• Deployed a retry/backoff hotfix to the ledger webhook handler.
• Requeued outstanding ledger tasks to complete seat assignments.
• Automated a 5% invoice credit + 2 hours of onboarding support for affected tenants (10% for flagged renewal-risk accounts).

If you still see missing seats or other issues, reply to this message or open a support ticket and we will prioritize your request. We value your feedback: https://redwood.io/incident-feedback. Were also hosting an office hours slot tomorrow for affected customers: https://redwood.io/office-hours."

maria_cs: I'll send that once Alex confirms rollout finished and we have the final tenant list.

luis_support: Updating the two tickets now and marking Tenant-Blue priority.

sarah_ops: Ready to run the credit script once you share the affected tenant IDs. Please include the impact window.

alex_se: Full rollout completed at 3700004588. No regressions in the 2m post-rollout window. Generating impacted list now.

maria_cs: Sent messages to all three tenants at 3700004595. Triggered office-hours invites and feedback link. Action items recap: Alex to share impacted list and credit script, Sarah to execute credits, Luis to update tickets, Emily/Jordan to handle renewal-priority touchpoints. I'll schedule a short post-incident sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
